reviews.t: Good product overall. Not my favorite.
reviews.x: Good but not amazing for making hair thicker. Overall, I really love this line.  This is not one of my most favorite products but it still works quite well and I would  recommend a friend try it. I have very thin, fine hair and have been trying a variety of products to fine the perfect one. So far, for me, the product that works best at helping to think em my hair at the root is either “Boldify Root Boosting spray” w/ “Boldify Hair Thickening spray.”

reviews.t: Love! A must get for fine hair
reviews.x: Yes!! This mousse if fantastic and smells great. I have fine hair and prefer mousse over any other styling product. This makes my hair fluffy and full and lasts all day! My hair in the morning is still nice! I’m curious to see how my hair handles the mousses after a few weeks

For the people complaining about it being crunchy and running out fast... Did it never occur to you that you're using WAY too much product? I have very long, thick curly hair and a bottle of this lasts me months. It only causes crunchiness when I use TOO MUCH. Learn how to use hair products before complaining they don't work! As for the complains about propane and butane... How do you think this product gets out of the bottle? Those are just things that propel product out of the bottle.. This pr

reviews.t: Not all the ingredients are on the website.  No returns with false advertising!
reviews.x: I am sending this product back.  I was talking to a friend who said she uses this product all the time. We looked on the website and it said nothing about butane or propane.  I went into amazon to order.  Again, nothing about butane or propane.  Amazon did have a disclosure about how ingredients may differ from container.  I actually read somewhere that they use no petroleum products.  I received the product and the second ingredient is butane and the 4th ingredient is propane.  No wonder it is
Absolutely love this. My hair dresser would use it and hair would do great but I could never replicate until I ordered this now my hubby and myself love the fullness and body it provides.
I love this product. I have very fine, straight hair.  This is the first product I've found that will actually give it some hold and body even on the rainiest or most humid days.
Love this product. I have fine hair and This gives me a lot of body. Without it my hair is too silky. Adds some grit. Sort of like second day hair.

reviews.t: A miracle product for my fine hair!
reviews.x: I was always a little hesitant to use a mousse for my naturally straight, fine hair. However, this product exceeded my expectations.  Before, my hair was always frizzy and lacked volume. Now, my hair is smooth and has a good amount of body/volume. I can’t believe I am just now discovering this product.  A miracle in a bottle for anyone with fine hair. A little goes a long way!

I love this mousse. I am a big fan of Amika products and this is no different. It’s light weight and smells great. It’s a little pricier but I think it’s worth it. I use it before I use my Dyson air wrap and it holds the curls SO well. Highly recommend
I love these products and the scent is phenomenal. Maybe it was my fault for not read I throughly but this isn’t smallest little can I e ever seen. Completely overpriced. Will not buy again.
The applicator quit working after 4 applications.  I can shake the can and there is still mousse in it but it will not come out.  I do not recommend this mousse.
I have fine hair and this gives me volume I love

I got this last minute for a trip, and I wasn’t super happy with the product. It’s a lot heavier than the other mouse I usually use and I could feel a lot of product buildup. It smells super good which is nice, but for the price, I don’t think this is worth it.

It goes on light weight but gives tons of volume without weighing down my hair. It also leaves a light but fresh clean scent.  The only con I have is the price but since it does what I need for my hair I'll pay the price. Great stuff!

I use this for my curly hair. It gives me volume, which is great, but I don't really love how my hair feels after using it. That said, it definitely works and I'll use it for days when I want the most volume I can get!
Purchased a small container of this to try. Read about this in  real simple magazine that it was fabulous for adding volume. It does not disappoint this product is great.

reviews.t: Be more specific....but not in tiny letters
reviews.x: Too expensive for a tiny bottle of muse. ....I don't recommend it.....and I don't know why it's called plus size, this is for a Barbie doll it's too too too tiny.😂

reviews.t: Defective Product and seller won't allow a return
reviews.x: I have been using the Amika Mousse for some time and love the product. However, the one I received last Friday comes out like a liquid instead of foamy like usual, no matter how much I shake the container and the Seller will not accept a return/replacement.  Very disappointed that the Seller won't stand behind their product!!

I loved this so much, I bought this big bottle after using my travel size up that I bought for testing. Scent smells amazing and my husband loves it when I put it in my hair (though he forgets its called plus size and calls it  thicc size lol). Highly recommend; smells great, lightweight, and works wonders.

I have very straight, baby fine hair with NO body to it.  I have tried other products and they are too heavy for my hair and the results are really not good!  This product gives some body and staying power to my hair without we33ighing it down or making it look greasy!  Also, I love the way it smells!

This was recommended to me by a friend with curly hair. My daughter has curly hair and I struggled with what product to use to keep her curls from frizzing. The mousse smells great and keeps the shape of her curls. Definitely more on the pricey side, but a good product nonetheless.

I have had consistent success with this product to give my hair volume and hold it in place softly without weighing it down. I have used it with short hair, longhair, straight hair and permed and consider it a keeper.

reviews.t: Stops working after a few uses
reviews.x: This is the second bottle that has stopped working after a few uses. The bottle still feels full, but I can't get the product to come out of the bottle. Don't waste your money!

reviews.t: Gives great volume and body but would check the ingredients
reviews.x: This hair product gives lots of volume. However, it has some ingredients I don’t care for. Still a good hair product to give volume and body for thin, fine hair
Amika Mousse is by far the best mousse I have ever used.  It has a lovely scent and leaves my fine hair soft and shiny and full of volume.  Highly recommend.

claims.text: Many reviewers with fine hair say it delivers strong volume and body that lasts all day.
Several reviewers praise the scent as great, fresh, or phenomenal.
Some reviewers find it overpriced or not worth the cost, including complaints about a tiny can.
A few reviewers report problems like crunchiness from overuse, product buildup, or the applicator failing.
One reviewer complains that butane and propane ingredients were not disclosed on the website.
